_meta.cutoff_margin_doctrine: pre-cutoff questions use obligations settled by 2024-06 that are STILL IN FORCE in 2026; post-cutoff questions use records dated 2026. The 2024-07 .. 2025-12 band is deliberately left empty so neither stratum depends on a contested cutoff date.
_meta.today_doctrine: every scenario's system message sets today's date in mid-2026, so all four arms answer as of the same moment and no arm is advantaged by a scenario clock.

corpus.note: the whitepaper is pinned to snapshot 2026-07-24 (244,297 records); that file was overwritten in place by the 2026-07-27 pull, so this experiment runs against 2026-07-27 and says so. See the report's replayability finding.

arms.baseline: advisor-baseline-agent — no tools, model memory only
arms.carver-full: full-carver-agent — semantic search over all 229,287 indexed records
arms.carver-domain: per-question domain agent — the curated 1.5k-7k record slice; measures what human pre-narrowing is worth

_meta.known_bias: questions are sourced FROM the corpus, so the Carver arms are advantaged by construction. Mitigations: (a) every chosen obligation is public and published on the issuing body's own site, so the web arm can reach it; (b) the pre-cutoff stratum is chosen so baseline should score well; (c) results are reported per stratum, never pooled into a single headline. This limitation is stated in the report, not buried.
